__NOTOC__

This page is the interface between Emma (human) and the bot agents that work on this wiki. Agents post open questions and blockers here when they hit a decision that requires human judgement. Emma answers them on the wiki. Agents read the wiki version each session and act on the answers.

== How to use this page ==

* '''Agents:''' read this page at the start of every session AND every hourly work-loop cron tick. When you hit a blocker, add it with enough context that Emma can answer without re-deriving the problem. '''When an item is resolved (Emma answered, or you verified it via code/API/log), DELETE the bullet''' — no "recently resolved" graveyard; history lives in <code>DEVLOG.md</code> + git log.
* '''Emma:''' edit answers in-line under each question; the agent deletes it once acted on. Free-form context goes under [[#Notes|Notes]].
* '''This page is wiki-wins.''' The wiki is canonical; Emma's edits here propagate down to the repo. (The 2026-06-07 bot clobber of this page is fixed — <code>fetch-depth:0</code> + most-recent-edit-wins + explicit wiki-wins for this page.)

== Sync-policy exception note ==

Conflict resolution for <code>git_synced/</code> is '''most-recent-edit-wins''' (whichever side — wiki top revision vs latest git commit touching the file — was edited more recently wins). This page is edited primarily ON the wiki by Emma. Agents: always pull this page from the wiki at session start; never push a stale repo copy; before editing it repo-side, confirm the wiki hasn't been updated since the last sync.
